checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is iteration_count exactly 1 for zero exponent with length <= 32?
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-0015, Trust Boundary: tb-005, Invariant: INV-002 (SG-002, EIP-7883)

audit_items.reasoning: EIP-7883 ModExp precompile gas computation (iteration_count formula for zero exponent) is an EVM execution-layer concern. The target repository is OffchainLabs/prysm (fusaka-audit branch), which is an Ethereum consensus layer client (beacon chain). Prysm does not implement EVM precompiles or gas pricing logic for precompiles such as ModExp. This audit item pertains to execution client implementations (go-ethereum, erigon, nethermind, besu), which are out of scope for this Prysm audit. No relevant code was found in the target_workspace despite exhaustive search for 'modexp', 'bigModExp', 'iteration_count', 'EIP-7883', and 'precompile' terms.

phase1.abstract_interpretation: No abstract states reachable in Prysm codebase for ModExp precompile iteration_count computation. Prysm is a consensus client and does not execute EVM transactions or precompiles.

phase2.symbolic_execution: Symbolic paths through Prysm do not include EVM precompile dispatch or ModExp gas computation. No relevant code paths exist.

phase2_5.state_analysis: No relevant state management for ModExp gas computation in Prysm consensus client codebase.

phase3.invariant_proving: Cannot prove or disprove EIP-7883 iteration_count invariant as the relevant code does not exist in the target codebase.

phase3_5.final_assessment: Out of scope: EVM precompile implementation not present in Prysm consensus client.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is large exponent multiplier 16 (not 8) in iteration_count formula?
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-0016, Trust Boundary: tb-005, Invariant: INV-003 (SG-002, EIP-7883)

audit_items.reasoning: EIP-7883 ModExp precompile gas computation (iteration_count multiplier of 16 vs old value of 8 for large exponents) is an EVM execution-layer concern. The target repository is OffchainLabs/prysm (fusaka-audit branch), an Ethereum consensus layer client that does not implement EVM precompiles or gas pricing logic. The multiplier constant (16) in the iteration_count formula for exponents > 32 bytes is defined in EIP-7883 and must be implemented by execution clients, not consensus clients. No relevant ModExp implementation was found in target_workspace.

phase1.abstract_interpretation: No abstract states in Prysm codebase implement EVM precompile dispatch or ModExp iteration_count formula. The multiplier constant check (16 vs 8) has no applicable code in this repository.

phase2.symbolic_execution: No symbolic paths through Prysm touch ModExp gas computation. No attack surface exists in this codebase for this vulnerability class.

phase2_5.state_analysis: No relevant state for ModExp multiplier constant in Prysm.

phase3.invariant_proving: Cannot verify multiplier invariant in execution client code as this is a consensus client. Out of scope.

phase3_5.final_assessment: Out of scope: ModExp precompile not implemented in Prysm consensus client.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas cost >= 500 for all inputs?
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-0017, Trust Boundaries: tb-005, tb-006, Invariant: INV-001 (SG-003, EIP-7883)

audit_items.reasoning: EIP-7883 ModExp minimum gas floor (500 gas, replacing EIP-2565's 200 gas minimum) is an EVM execution-layer concern. OffchainLabs/prysm is a consensus layer (beacon chain) client that does not implement the ModExp precompile (EIP address 0x05) or compute precompile gas costs. The gas floor invariant (max(500, computed_cost)) must be verified in execution clients. No ModExp gas computation code exists in the Prysm target_workspace. The gas-related code in Prysm only concerns block gas limit management, which is unrelated to precompile execution gas pricing.

phase1.abstract_interpretation: Prysm processes beacon blocks and manages the consensus layer. Gas accounting at the precompile level (ModExp min 500 gas) is delegated entirely to the execution layer via the Engine API. No abstract state in Prysm models or enforces the ModExp gas floor.

phase2.symbolic_execution: Prysm forwards execution payloads to the execution engine without computing EVM gas costs for individual operations. The 500 gas minimum for ModExp cannot be reached through any symbolic path in Prysm.

phase2_5.state_analysis: No precompile gas state management in Prysm.

phase3.invariant_proving: Cannot prove gas floor invariant in a codebase that does not implement EVM precompile execution.

phase3_5.final_assessment: Out of scope: EIP-7883 minimum gas floor check requires execution client codebase audit.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does ModExp gas formula NOT include /3 divisor?
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-0018, Trust Boundary: tb-006, Invariant: INV-002 (SG-003, EIP-7883)

audit_items.reasoning: EIP-7883 modifies the ModExp gas formula to remove the '/3' divisor that was present in EIP-2565. This is an EVM execution-layer change that must be verified in execution clients (go-ethereum, erigon, nethermind, besu). The target OffchainLabs/prysm is a consensus layer client. The formula regression risk (accidentally keeping the EIP-2565 divisor) applies only to execution client implementations, not to Prysm which does not compute EVM transaction gas. No gas formula code for ModExp exists in Prysm's target_workspace.

phase1.abstract_interpretation: Prysm abstracts all EVM execution through the Engine API. Gas formula details (presence or absence of /3 divisor) are implemented and enforced by the execution engine (e.g., geth), not by Prysm. No relevant abstract state.

phase2.symbolic_execution: No symbolic execution paths in Prysm implement ModExp gas formula logic. The /3 divisor check has no applicable code path.

phase2_5.state_analysis: No relevant gas formula state in Prysm.

phase3.invariant_proving: Cannot verify absence of /3 divisor in execution code not present in this repository.

phase3_5.final_assessment: Out of scope: ModExp gas formula verification requires execution client audit.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ModExp gas computation deterministic across all clients?
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-0019, Trust Boundary: tb-006, Consensus-critical

audit_items.reasoning: Cross-client determinism of ModExp gas computation is a concern that applies to execution layer clients (go-ethereum, erigon, nethermind, besu) that independently implement the EVM precompile. While consensus-critical divergence could theoretically affect the Ethereum network, OffchainLabs/prysm (the target) is a consensus client that relies on a paired execution client for all EVM execution. Prysm does not implement ModExp gas computation and therefore cannot introduce divergence in this computation. The cross-client divergence risk for ModExp must be audited in the execution client implementations, not in Prysm. No relevant code was found in target_workspace.

phase1.abstract_interpretation: Prysm's consensus logic treats execution payloads as opaque data validated by the execution engine. ModExp gas determinism is an execution-layer invariant; Prysm cannot enforce or violate it directly. The cross-client consistency check must compare execution clients against each other, not the consensus client.

phase2.symbolic_execution: No code paths in Prysm compute ModExp gas. Cross-client divergence for this precompile is not a Prysm-specific attack surface.

phase2_5.state_analysis: No ModExp gas computation state in Prysm. Cross-client comparison requires execution client analysis.

phase3.invariant_proving: Cannot verify cross-client determinism of ModExp gas in a codebase that does not implement the precompile.

phase3_5.final_assessment: Out of scope: ModExp cross-client determinism check requires execution client implementations, not consensus client audit.
